description: Feature backlog - Product Owner owns priority

items.title: backlog check should show which verify command failed
items.intent: When backlog check <ID> fails an AC verify command, the output must print the exact command that failed and its exit code so a developer can reproduce and debug the failure without guessing which check broke.
steps: In check_readiness_gates() in .aishore/aishore (around line 910), add a new section after the dependency check that iterates over AC entries with verify commands
For each AC with a verify field, run the verify command in a subshell and capture the exit code
When a verify command fails (exit code != 0), append the command text and exit code to warnings using the same format as other warnings, e.g. '  - AC verify failed (exit N): <command>'
Keep format consistent with existing log_* style — use the warnings string accumulation pattern already in the function

acceptanceCriteria.text: Failed verify command text appears in backlog check output
acceptanceCriteria.verify: tid=$(.aishore/aishore backlog add --json "{\"title\":\"_groom_ac_test\",\"intent\":\"groom test intent placeholder twenty chars\",\"type\":\"feat\",\"priority\":\"could\",\"steps\":[\"implement the test feature\"],\"acceptanceCriteria\":[{\"text\":\"fails\",\"verify\":\"exit 99\"}],\"readyForSprint\":false}" 2>&1 | grep -oE "[A-Z]+-[0-9]+"); out=$(.aishore/aishore backlog check "$tid" 2>&1); .aishore/aishore backlog rm "$tid" --force 2>/dev/null; echo "$out" | grep -q "exit 99"

items.groomingNotes: Implemented in commit 692c488 — added AC verify execution loop to check_readiness_gates(). AC verified passing.

items.title: backlog list should show fail count for items with sprint failures
items.intent: backlog list must show a FAILS column with the failure count for items where failCount > 0, so developers can immediately see which items are stuck without opening each one.
steps: In cmd_backlog_list() in .aishore/lib/cmd-backlog-read.sh, add (.failCount // 0) to the jq projection alongside the existing fields
Add a FAILS column (6 chars wide) to the printf header and separator lines after the READY column
When rendering each row, show the failCount as a number when > 0, or "-" when 0

acceptanceCriteria.text: FAILS column header appears in backlog list output
Items with failures show a non-zero fail count in backlog list

items.groomingNotes: Implemented directly — added FAILS column to backlog list with failCount display. AC verified passing.
